```markdown
# CivilDocs Pilot Copy and Presentation Refinement

## Audit Finding

The current pilot entry communicates the product purpose well, but repeats implementation detail across the entry screen, workspace, profile, feedback, settings, and footer. The most distracting patterns are internal labels such as field-ledger identifiers, recurring explanations about unavailable future features, duplicated local-storage wording, and verbose pilot-plan context. These statements dilute the central task: choosing and preparing a contractor document.

## Refinement Principles

The revised interface will retain the disclosures a tester needs: affirmative Terms acceptance, local-only storage, disabled pilot purchasing, and the professional-review warning. It will remove or shorten surrounding implementation detail, consolidate repeated device-local messages, and use task-focused wording. The document register remains the primary action.

## Visual Direction

The supporting visual is a low-contrast engineering field sketch with drainage, bridge, survey, and contour motifs. It is intentionally text-free, subdued, and placed as a supporting visual rather than a marketing hero. The product continues to use its navy, paper, and amber engineering-document palette.

## Responsive Review

The desktop review confirms that the document register remains the primary object, while the rate schedule now reads as an administrative continuation rather than a marketing card group. The image is confined to a small technical substrate inside the review panel. The 375×812 review confirms that the register, Terms notice, visual panel, rate schedule, and footer stack cleanly without clipped controls. The watermark crowds the small brand tagline on narrow phones, so the compact header requires one final responsive adjustment before release.

The final 375×812 header review removes the narrow-screen tagline and retains a clear CivilDocs mark and separate Pilot Test watermark. The register heading, all six rows, Terms control, and status note remain readable without overlap.

The current-build interaction review confirmed the streamlined entry labels, Terms checkbox, concise accepted-state announcement, and all six document routes. Terms acceptance remains affirmative, keyboard-reachable, and stored locally as intended.

The CD-01 workspace opens with the compact feedback note, saved-draft PDF and Word controls, and the concise local-draft indicator intact. Settings opens from the workspace with a labelled modal, a focused close control, the appearance action, and the saved-feedback manager. No generation request was made during this review.

The final accessibility check confirms that the Settings dialog exposes `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby="settings-title"`, and `aria-describedby="settings-note"`. The close control receives initial focus, and the next keyboard Tab action reaches the appearance control. The Terms and workspace actions retain their visible labels and live-status support.

The visible close control returns to the entry screen as expected. The Escape key did not close the Settings dialog, so keyboard dismissal is being added before release.

After adding keyboard dismissal support, a fresh entry review again confirmed that the concise Terms gate announces acceptance and permits document access without exposing internal implementation wording.

The refined CD-01 workspace restored its browser-local draft and successfully activated **Download draft PDF** without making an AI request. The Word-compatible export is checked in the next interaction.

The same restored draft successfully activated **Download draft Word**. The refined `pilot-access-status`, `entry-feedback-status`, and `draft-export-status` elements each retain `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"`.

The refined PDF and Word downloads were confirmed in the browser download directory as `Bid_Package_Chimwemwe_Clinic_Extension_Draft_2026-08-21.pdf` and `.doc`. The Settings dialog now closes with Escape and returns focus to the Settings trigger, completing the keyboard-dismissal check.

The saved-feedback manager opens from Settings with a labelled modal and a clear browser-local empty state. Its Escape behavior is verified in the next interaction.

Escape closes the saved-feedback manager and returns focus to **View feedback**. Both refined dialogs now support a visible close action, Escape dismissal, and focus return to the originating control.

The keyboard-only pass begins at the entry register: Tab visibly reaches the M1 document row with the existing focus treatment.

Subsequent Tab navigation continues through the document-register rows without losing the visible focus state. The Terms-control interaction is verified next.

The labelled Terms checkbox receives focus and toggles with Space, updating the concise accepted-state announcement.

With Terms accepted, the M1 document row receives focus and opens the CD-01 workspace with Enter. The focused workspace controls are checked next.

The active workspace exposes both PDF and Word saved-draft export actions for keyboard activation.

The visible Word export control receives focus and activates with Enter, completing the keyboard export check without invoking AI generation.

The workspace back control receives focus and returns to the document register with Enter, preserving the saved-draft export status message.

From the document register, the Settings trigger receives focus and opens with Enter. The keyboard-only pass therefore covers the entry register, Terms acceptance, document opening, saved-draft export, back navigation, and Settings access.

The final automated control audit confirms that the Terms checkbox, document route, back navigation, Settings trigger, and PDF/Word export actions remain native keyboard-focusable controls, with Escape dismissal wired for both modal panels. Final validation passed **48 test files and 180 tests**, TypeScript checking, and a production build.

## Publication verification

Checkpoint `ae939b2a` was saved for the refined release. The first two public-domain reads continued to return the preceding bundle, so the public verification remained pending normal deployment propagation rather than being recorded prematurely.

After propagation, the published domain served the refined bundle. The live entry screen showed **“Zambia · contractor documents,” “Document register,” “Choose a document,”** the concise device-local wording, the technical visual panel, and the **“Rate schedule”** presentation. The public release also retained all six document-route buttons, the Terms checkbox, and the Settings, pricing, and Terms controls.

The published desktop render showed the low-contrast engineering sketch confined to the top of the working-documents panel. Opening live Settings displayed its labelled modal, and Escape closed it successfully, returning the interface to the normal entry screen.

The published saved-feedback manager also opened from Settings with its visible **Saved route feedback** title, close control, and browser-local empty state. Its Escape/focus-return verification follows.

Escape closed the published saved-feedback dialog while leaving Settings open, and focus returned to the **View feedback** trigger (`feedback-manager-open-button`). The live visual and both refined modal keyboard behaviors are therefore verified on the published bundle.

The final Cloudflare-ready handoff is **`CivilDocs_Cloudflare_Shipping_2026-08-21.zip`**. It was refreshed against the final public-verification record, checkpoint `113f943a`, and its ZIP integrity check completed successfully.
```

```javascript
document.getElementById("back-button").addEventListener("click",showHome);document.getElementById("another-button").addEventListener("click",showHome);document.getElementById("download-button").addEventListener("click",downloadLatestPdf);document.getElementById("settings-link").addEventListener("click",openSettings);document.getElementById("settings-close-button").addEventListener("click",closeSettings);document.querySelector("[data-close-settings]").addEventListener("click",closeSettings);document.getElementById("feedback-manager-open-button").addEventListener("click",openFeedbackManager);document.getElementById("feedback-manager-close-button").addEventListener("click",closeFeedbackManager);document.querySelector("[data-close-feedback-manager]").addEventListener("click",closeFeedbackManager);feedbackManagerClear.addEventListener("click",clearAllFeedback);feedbackManagerList.addEventListener("click",handleFeedbackManagerClick);document.getElementById("pricing-link").addEventListener("click",showPricing);document.getElementById("pricing-back-button").addEventListener("click",returnFromInformationView);document.getElementById("terms-link").addEventListener("click",showTerms);document.getElementById("terms-back-button").addEventListener("click",returnFromInformationView);document.querySelectorAll(".pricing-contact-button").forEach(button=>button.addEventListener("click",()=>showFeedbackForPlan(button.dataset.pricingPlan)));document.getElementById("pilot-feedback-form").addEventListener("submit",preparePilotFeedback);document.getElementById("feedback-copy-button").addEventListener("click",copyPreparedFeedback);entryFeedbackForm.addEventListener("submit",saveRouteFeedback);document.getElementById("entry-feedback-dismiss").addEventListener("click",dismissEntryFeedback);document.getElementById("entry-feedback-skip").addEventListener("click",dismissEntryFeedback);form.addEventListener("submit",submitDocument);fields.addEventListener("click",handleDynamicClick);fields.addEve function applyTheme(theme){const isDark=theme==="dark";document.documentElement.dataset.theme=theme;themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(isDark));themeToggle.textContent=`Appearance: ${isDark?"Dark":"Light"}`;}

function feedbackRatingLabel(rating){return ({clear:"Clear",uncertain:"A little unclear",confusing:"Confusing"})[rating]||"Not recorded";}
function renderFeedbackManager(){const entries=readEntryFeedback(window.localStorage);feedbackManagerClear.hidden=!entries.length;feedbackManagerList.innerHTML=entries.length?entries.map((entry,index)=>`<article class="feedback-manager-entry"><div><p class="feedback-manager-entry__meta">${escapeHtml(entry.route)} · ${escapeHtml(feedbackRatingLabel(entry.rating))}</p><p class="feedback-manager-entry__date">${escapeHtml(new Date(entry.createdAt).toLocaleString())}</p>${entry.note?`<p class="feedback-manager-entry__note">${escapeHtml(entry.note)}</p>`:"<p class=\"feedback-manager-entry__note is-empty\">No optional comment.</p>"}</div><button class="text-button feedback-manager-entry__delete" type="button" data-delete-feedback="${index}" aria-label="Delete saved feedback for ${escapeHtml(entry.route)}">Delete</button></article>`).join(""):'<div class="feedback-manager-empty"><strong>No saved route feedback yet.</strong><span>Open a document route and save the optional prompt if you would like to keep a note here.</span></div>';}

function closeFeedbackManager(){feedbackManagerPanel.hidden=true;document.body.classList.remove("feedback-manager-open");lastFeedbackManagerTrigger?.focus?.();}
function handleDialogEscape(event){if(event.key!=="Escape")return;if(!feedbackManagerPanel.hidden){event.preventDefault();closeFeedbackManager();return;}if(!settingsPanel.hidden){event.preventDefault();closeSettings();}}
function handleFeedbackManagerClick(event){const button=event.target.closest("[data-delete-feedback]");if(!button)return;removeEntryFeedback(window.localStorage,Number(button.dataset.deleteFeedback));renderFeedbackManager();}

function updatePilotTermsGate(){const acceptance=readPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage),accepted=pilotTermsCheckbox.checked||acceptance.isCurrent,freeButton=document.getElementById("test-free-button");freeButton.disabled=!accepted;freeButton.setAttribute("aria-disabled",String(!accepted));if(pilotTermsCheckbox.checked){pilotTermsConsent.classList.remove("is-invalid","is-shaking");pilotTermsCheckbox.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");}pilotAccessStatus.textContent=accepted?"Terms accepted. Use CivilDocs for free.":"Agree to the Pilot Terms to unlock CivilDocs.";}
function startFreePilot(){const acceptance=readPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage);if(!pilotTermsCheckbox.checked&&!acceptance.isCurrent){pilotTermsConsent.classList.remove("is-shaking");void pilotTermsConsent.offsetWidth;pilotTermsConsent.classList.add("is-invalid","is-shaking");pilotTermsCheckbox.setAttribute("aria-invalid","true");pilotAccessStatus.textContent="Agree to the Pilot Terms before using CivilDocs.";pilotTermsCheckbox.focus();return;}if(!acceptance.isCurrent)recordPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage);sessionStorage.setItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY,"open");showHome();}
function openPilotModule(id){const acceptance=readPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage);if(!pilotTermsCheckbox.checked&&!acceptance.isCurrent){pilotTermsConsent.classList.remove("is-shaking");void pilotTermsConsent.offsetWidth;pilotTermsConsent.classList.add("is-invalid", "is-shaking");pilotTermsCheckbox.setAttribute("aria-invalid","true");pilotAccessStatus.textContent="Agree to the Pilot Terms before opening a document.";pilotTermsCheckbox.focus();return;}if(!acceptance.isCurrent)recordPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage);sessionStorage.setItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY,"open");showForm(id);}

function showHome(){const acceptance=readPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage);if(sessionStorage.getItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY)!=="open"||!acceptance.isCurrent){sessionStorage.removeItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY);showView(accessView);return;}cancelActiveRequest();if(selectedModule)saveDraft();form.reset();clearStatus();selectedModule=null;currentDraftExportActions.hidden=true;renderDraftExports();showView(homeView);}
function showTerms(){cancelActiveRequest();clearStatus();showView(termsView);}

function qaStressSessionActive(){return isQaStressSession(window.location.search,window.sessionStorage);}
function renderQaStressNotice(){qaStressNotice.hidden=qaStressNoticeHidden(window.location.search,window.sessionStorage);}
function renderFairUsePanel(){const usage=currentFairUse(),state=fairUseStatus(usage),bar=document.getElementById("fair-use-meter-bar"),warning=document.getElementById("fair-use-warning");document.getElementById("fair-use-used").textContent=`${state.used} used`;document.getElementById("fair-use-remaining").textContent=`${state.remaining} remaining`;bar.style.width=`${Math.round(state.ratio*100)}%`;bar.dataset.state=state.state;const messages={available:`${state.remaining} of ${state.limit} device-local Founding Engineer generations remain this month.`,approaching:`Fair-use reminder: ${state.remaining} of ${state.limit} device-local generations remain this month.`,capped:`This browser has reached its ${state.limit}-generation local pilot cap for the month.`};document.getElementById("fair-use-summary").textContent=messages[state.state];document.getElementById("fair-use-detail").textContent=`${Math.round(state.ratio*100)}% of the device-local allowance recorded for ${usage.month}.`;warning.hidden=state.state==="available";warning.textContent=state.state==="approaching"?`Approaching fair-use cap: ${state.remaining} generation${state.remaining===1?"":"s"} remain on this device this month.`:state.state==="capped"?`Local pilot cap reached. New AI requests are paused in this browser until the next local calendar month.`:"";}
function showFeedbackForPlan(plan){showPricing();document.getElementById("feedback-plan").value=plan||"Founding Engineer";window.setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById("feedback-section").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}),0);}
function entryFeedbackDismissalKey(moduleId){return `civildocs.entry-flow-feedback-dismissed.v1:${moduleId}`;}
function showEntryFeedback(moduleId){const module=modules[moduleId];if(!module||sessionStorage.getItem(entryFeedbackDismissalKey(moduleId))==="1"){entryFeedbackPanel.hidden=true;return;}entryFeedbackForm.reset();entryFeedbackPanel.dataset.module=moduleId;entryFeedbackRoute.textContent=`${module.code} — ${module.name}`;entryFeedbackStatus.textContent="Saved on this device.";entryFeedbackPanel.hidden=false;}
function dismissEntryFeedback(){const moduleId=entryFeedbackPanel.dataset.module;if(moduleId)sessionStorage.setItem(entryFeedbackDismissalKey(moduleId),"1");entryFeedbackPanel.hidden=true;}
function saveRouteFeedback(event){event.preventDefault();const moduleId=entryFeedbackPanel.dataset.module,rating=entryFeedbackForm.elements.entryRating.value,note=entryFeedbackForm.elements.entryNote.value;const result=saveEntryFeedback(window.localStorage,{route:modules[moduleId]?.code||moduleId,rating,note});if(!result.saved){entryFeedbackStatus.textContent="Choose one response before saving feedback.";entryFeedbackForm.querySelector('[name="entryRating"]')?.focus();return;}entryFeedbackStatus.textContent="Saved. You can keep working.";window.setTimeout(dismissEntryFeedback,1600);}
function preparedFeedbackMessage(){const feedbackForm=document.getElementById("pilot-feedback-form"),values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(feedbackForm).entries()),name=String(values.name||"").trim(),plan=String(values.plan||"Founding Engineer"),message=String(values.message||"").trim();return {plan,message,text:`CivilDocs pilot feedback\n\nName: ${name||"Not supplied"}\nPlan of interest: ${plan}\n\nQuestion or feedback:\n${message}\n\nSent from the CivilDocs pilot feedback form.`};}
function preparePilotFeedback(e){e.preventDefault();const prepared=preparedFeedbackMessage(),result=document.getElementById("feedback-result"),preview=document.getElementById("feedback-preview"),emailLink=document.getElementById("feedback-email-link");if(!prepared.message){document.getElementById("feedback-message").classList.add("is-invalid");return;}document.getElementById("feedback-message").classList.remove("is-invalid");preview.value=prepared.text;result.hidden=false;emailLink.hidden=!SUPPORT_EMAIL;if(SUPPORT_EMAIL){const subject=encodeURIComponent(`CivilDocs pilot feedback — ${prepared.plan}`);emailLink.href=`mailto:${encodeURIComponent(SUPPORT_EMAIL)}?subject=${subject}&body=${encodeURIComponent(prepared.text)}`;document.getElementById("feedback-result-text").textContent="Your message is ready. You may copy it or open a pre-addressed email draft; nothing has been sent automatically.";}else document.getElementById("feedback-result-text").textContent="Your message is ready to copy. A public support email has not yet been configured, so nothing has been sent automatically.";}
async function copyPreparedFeedback(){const text=document.getElementById("feedback-preview").value;if(!text)return;try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);document.getElementById("feedback-result-text").textContent="Feedback message copied. Send it through your agreed pilot contact channel.";}catch{document.getElementById("feedback-preview").focus();document.getElementById("feedback-preview").select();document.getElementById("feedback-result-text").textContent="Select and copy the prepared message, then send it through your agreed pilot contact channel.";}}
function showForm(id){if(sessionStorage.getItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY)!=="open"||!readPilotTermsAcceptance(window.localStorage).isCurrent){sessionStorage.removeItem(PILOT_ACCESS_KEY);showView(accessView);return;}cancelActiveRequest();selectedModule=id;const m=modules[id];document.getElementById("form-code").textContent=m.code;document.getElementById("form-title").textContent=m.name;document.getElementById("form-description").textContent=m.description;document.getElementById("form-note").textContent="Saved on this device.";fields.innerHTML=m.fields.map(renderField).join("");clearStatus();restoreDraft(id);applyProfileDefaultsToForm();saveDraft();currentDraftExportActions.hidden=false;if(id==="payment")updatePaymentFormWarning();renderRequestStage({mode:"hidden"});showEntryFeedback(id);updateNetworkState();showView(formView);}
function renderField([name,label,type,required,extra]){const req=required?" required":"",full=type==="textarea"||type==="dynamic"?" full":"";if(type==="textarea")return `<div class="field${full}"><label for="${name}">${label}</label><textarea id="${name}" name="${name}"${req}></textarea></div>`;if(type==="select")return `<div class="field"><label for="${name}">${label}</label><select id="${name}" name="${name}"${req}><option value="">Select</option>${extra.map(x=>`<option value="${x}"${x==="ZMW"?" selected":""}>${x}</option>`).join("")}</select></div>`;if(type==="dynamic")return `<div class="dynamic-field" data-dynamic="${extra}"><span class="dynamic-label">${label}</span><div class="dynamic-list">${dynamicRow(extra)}</div><button class="add-row" type="button" data-add="${extra}">+ Add Item</button></div>`;return `<div class="field"><label for="${name}">${label}</label><input id="${name}" name="${name}" type="${type}" value="${extra&&type!=="select"?extra:""}"${req}></div>`;}
function dynamicRow(kind){if(kind==="projects")return `<div class="dynamic-row projects"><input name="projectNameItem" placeholder="Project name" required><input name="projectClientItem" placeholder="Client" required><input name="projectValueItem" type="number" placeholder="Value (ZMW)" required><input name="projectYearItem" type="number" placeholder="Year" required><input name="projectCertificateItem" placeholder="Completion certificate / reference"><input name="projectEvidenceItem" placeholder="Evidence reference"><select name="projectEvidenceStatus"><option>Available</option><option>Partial</option><option>Missing</option></select><button type="button" class="row-remove" aria-label="Remove project">Remove</button></div>`;return `<div class="dynamic-row materials"><input name="materialItem" placeholder="Material name (e.g. Cement)" required><input name="materialQuantityItem" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="Quantity"><input name="materialUnitItem" placeholder="Unit (e.g. bag)"><input name="materialBaseRateItem" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="Base rate (ZMW)"><input name="materialCurrentRateItem" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="Current rate (ZMW)"><input name="materialSourceItem" placeholder="Invoice / index source"><button type="button" class="row-remove" aria-label="Remove material">Remove</button></div>`;}
function handleDynamicClick(e){const add=e.target.closest("[data-add]");if(add){add.previousElementSibling.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",dynamicRow(add.dataset.add));saveDraft();return;}const remove=e.target.closest(".row-remove");if(remove){const list=remove.closest(".dynamic-list");if(list.children.length>1){remove.closest(".dynamic-row").remove();saveDraft();}else showStatus("Keep at least one item in this list.","error");}}
function paymentOverrunMessage(overrun){const limitLabel=Number(overrun.approvedVariationValue||0)!==0?"adjusted contract sum":"contract sum";return `Warning: cumulative value ${formatReviewMoney(overrun.cumulativeValue)} exceeds the ${limitLabel} ${formatReviewMoney(overrun.contractSum)} by ${formatReviewMoney(overrun.excess)}. Verify the valuation, approved variations, contract instructions, and certifier authority before confirming.`;}
function updatePaymentFormWarning(){if(selectedModule!=="payment")return;const values=collectValues();const cumulative=Number(values.previousCertified||0)+Number(values.valueThisPeriod||0);const overrun=getPaymentCertificateOverrun({cumulativeValue:cumulative},values);if(overrun.exceeds)showStatus(paymentOverrunMessage(overrun),"warning");else if(status.classList.contains("warning"))clearStatus();}
function updatePaymentReviewWarning(data){const existing=document.getElementById("payment-overrun-warning");if(existing)existing.remove();const overrun=getPaymentCertificateOverrun(data,reviewState?.values||{});if(overrun.exceeds)reviewSummaryView.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin",`<div id="payment-overrun-warning" class="status-message warning" role="alert"><strong>${escapeHtml(paymentOverrunMessage(overrun))}</strong></div>`);}
function handlePaymentInput(){updatePaymentFormWarning();}
function handleFormInput(){handlePaymentInput();saveDraft();}
function collectValues(){const values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());if(selectedModule==="grade")values.completedProjects=[...fields.querySelectorAll(".projects")].map(r=>({projectName:r.querySelector('[name="projectNameItem"]').value,client:r.querySelector('[name="projectClientItem"]').value,value:Number(r.querySelector('[name="projectValueItem"]').value||0),year:r.querySelector('[name="projectYearItem"]').value,completionCertificate:r.querySelector('[name="projectCertificateItem"]').value,evidenceReference:r.querySelector('[name="projectEvidenceItem"]').value,evidenceStatus:r.querySelector('[name="projectEvidenceStatus"]').value}));if(selectedModule==="escalation"){values.materialsSchedule=[...fields.querySelectorAll(".materials")].map(r=>({material:r.querySelector('[name="materialItem"]').value.trim(),quantity:Number(r.querySelector('[name="materialQuantityItem"]').value||0),unit:r.querySelector('[name="materialUnitItem"]').value.trim(),baseUnitPrice:Number(r.querySelector('[name="materialBaseRateItem"]').value||0),currentUnitPrice:Number(r.querySelector('[name="materialCurrentRateItem"]').value||0),source:r.querySelector('[name="materialSourceItem"]').value.trim()})).filter(x=>x.material);values.materials=values.materialsSchedule.map(x=>x.material);}return values;}
function validate(){let okay=true,firstInvalid=null;fields.querySelectorAll("[required]").forEach(i=>{const bad=!String(i.value||"").trim();i.classList.toggle("is-invalid",bad);if(bad&&!firstInvalid)firstInvalid=i;okay=okay&&!bad;});if(!okay){showStatus("Complete every required field before generating the document.","error");firstInvalid?.focus();return false;}if(selectedModule==="payment"){const errors=getPaymentFormValidationErrors(collectValues());if(errors.length){showStatus(errors.map(error=>escapeHtml(error)).join("<br>"),"error");return false;}}return true;}
async function submitDocument(e){e.preventDefault();clearStatus();if(!validate())return;if(!canStartFairUseGeneration(window.localStorage)){const usage=fairUseStatus(currentFairUse());showStatus(`Local pilot cap reached: this browser has recorded ${usage.used} of ${usage.limit} completed AI generations this month. The local tracker resets next month; see Pricing & Fair Use for details.`,"warning");renderFairUsePanel();return;}const values=collectValues();lastPrompt=buildPrompt(selectedModule,values);setLoading(true);try{const data=await callGemini(lastPrompt);const usage=recordCompletedFairUseGeneration(window.localStorage);latestPdf=renderPdf(selectedModule,data,values);latestFilename=filename(modules[selectedModule].short,values.projectName||values.companyName||"Document");document.getElementById("result-description").textContent=`Your ${modules[selectedModule].name} is ready to download as a PDF.`;document.getElementById("result-success-note").textContent=usage.state==="capped"?`Your PDF is ready. This completed generation reached this browser’s local monthly pilot cap of ${FOUNDING_ENGINEER_MONTHLY_LIMIT}; new requests resume next local calendar month.`:usage.state==="approaching"?`Your PDF is ready. function previewOnlySlowFailure(moduleId, signal) {
  const mode = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("civilDocsQa");
  const isPreview = window.location.hostname.endsWith(".manus.computer") || window.location.hostname === "localhost";
  if (!isPreview || mode !== `${moduleId}-slow-fail`) return null;
  return new Promise((_, reject) => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { const error = new Error(`Preview-only ${moduleId} slow-failure check`); error.code = "UPSTREAM_CAPACITY"; reject(error); }, 1400);
    signal?.addEventListener("abort", () => { window.clearTimeout(timer); reject(new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError")); }, { once:true });
  });
}
async function callGemini(promptText,signal,moduleId=selectedModule){const previewFailure=previewOnlySlowFailure(moduleId,signal);if(previewFailure)return previewFailure;const response=await fetch(GEMINI_PROXY_ENDPOINT,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({prompt:promptText}),signal});const data=await response.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!response.ok)throw new GeminiProxyError(response.status,data?.code);const raw=(data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts||[]).map(part=>part.text||"").join("");if(!raw)throw new GeminiProxyError(502,"UPSTREAM_EMPTY_RESPONSE");const parsed=parseGeminiJson(raw,candidate=>validateGeneratedResponse(moduleId,candidate).ok);return parsed;}

  pdf.rect(0, 0, 210, 11, "F");
  pdf.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  pdf.setFontSize(9);
  pdf.text("CIVILDOCS", 15, 7);
  pdf.setTextColor(...navy);
  pdf.setFontSize(13);
  pdf.text("Corrective Action Register", 15, 19);
  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  pdf.setFontSize(8.5);
  pdf.text("This register assigns the action owner, required action, due date and supporting evidence for each inspection item.", 15, 25);
  pdf.autoTable({
    startY: 30,
    head: [["Item", "Location", "Severity", "Responsible party", "Corrective action", "Due date", "Evidence reference"]],
    body: items.map(item => [
      item.itemNo,
      item.area,
      item.severityIfDefect,
      item.responsibleParty || (source.contractor ? "Contractor" : "To be assigned"),
      item.actionRequired || "Confirm corrective action",
      item.targetCloseoutDate || item.dueDate || "To be agreed",
      item.evidenceReference || "Not supplied",
    ]),
    margin: { left: 15, right: 15 },
    theme: "grid",
    styles: { font: "helvetica", fontSize: 7.4, cellPadding: 2, overflow: "linebreak" },
    headStyles: { fillColor: amber, textColor: [255, 255, 255], fontStyle: "bold" },
    columnStyles: { 1: { cellWidth: 24 }, 3: { cellWidth: 24 }, 4: { cellWidth: 52 }, 6: { cellWidth: 24 } },
  });
  addFooters(pdf);
  return pdf;
};

const baseBuildPrompt = buildPrompt;
buildPrompt = function(type, values) {
  if (type === "bid") {
    const overrideText = String(values.rateOverrides || "").trim();
    return `Prepare a Zambia Public Procurement Authority-style bidder-side priced Bill of Quantities (Schedule of Prices) and technical-proposal preparation aid for a works tender. It must not replace the employer-issued tender document, Bid Data Sheet (BDS), Section IV forms, employer requirements or addenda. Project: ${values.projectName}. Location: ${values.location}. Employer: ${values.client}. Tenderer: ${values.preparedBy}. Currency: ${values.currency}. Scope: ${values.description}. Stated budget: ${values.budget || "not supplied"}. Procurement reference: ${values.procurementReference || "[not supplied — mark for bidder completion]"}. Invitation for Bids No.: ${values.invitationForBidNo || "[not supplied — mark for bidder completion]"}. Bid validity: ${values.bidValidityDays ? `${values.bidValidityDays} days` : "[not supplied — mark for bidder completion]"}. Discount: ${values.discountAmount || 0}. Contractor’s representative: ${values.contractorRepresentative || "[not supplied — mark for bidder completion]"}. Use a formal BOQ cover with title, employer, location, bidder, currency, Bill No. 1 and the supplied tender particulars. Organise items under applicable numbered sections: 1.00 PRELIMINARIES AND GENERAL; 2.00 EARTHWORKS AND EXCAVATION; 3.00 CONCRETE AND REINFORCEMENT; 4.00 MASONRY AND STRUCTURAL WORKS; 5.00 ROOFING, FINISHES AND FITTINGS; 6.00 DRAINAGE, EXTERNAL WORKS AND REINSTATEMENT; 7.00 OTHER MEASURED WORKS. Use hierarchical item numbering such as 1.01, 1.02, 2.01. Every item must include description, unit, quantity, unit rate and amount. Rates must cover applicable duties, taxes and levies unless the issued tender says otherwise; do not add a universal contingency or VAT line to the tender price. Use the CivilDocs Zambia material reference rates unless an explicit user rate takes priority: ${materialRateReferenceForPrompt()}. User rate override: ${overrideText || "None."} QUANTITY RULES: ${ZAMBIAN_QUANTITY_RULES} Practical increments: ${practicalQuantityRulesForPrompt()}. Apply the rules to every material and every scope size. Accuracy and practical procurement take priority over matching budget. If the minimum viable described scope exceeds the stated budget, do not force the total; set notes exactly to: Note: the described scope of works exceeds the stated budget of ${values.budget || "[budget]"}. A realistic minimum-viable BOQ is shown above; consider increasing budget or reducing scope. The technicalProposal must include executiveSummary, methodology, personnel, equipment, siteOrganization, mobilisationSchedule, constructionSchedule and otherInformation. Do not invent bidder qualifications, financial capacity, experience, owned equipment, staff credentials, tender references or BDS requirements. Instead use a clear bidder-completion / attachment instruction for evidence not supplied. Respond only with raw JSON matching this exact schema: {"title":"BILL OF QUANTITIES (SCHEDULE OF PRICES)","tenderDetails":{"procurementTitle":string,"procurementReference":string,"invitationForBidNo":string,"employer":string,"location":string,"issueDate":string,"submissionDate":string,"bidder":string,"currency":string,"billNumber":"Bill No. 1","bidValidity":string,"discountAmount":number,"contractorRepresentative":string},"projectDetails":{"projectName":string,"location":string,"client":string,"preparedBy":string,"date":string,"currency":string},"boqItems":[{"itemNo":string,"sectionNumber":string,"sectionTitle":string,"description":string,"unit":string,"quantity":number,"rate":number,"amount":number}],"subtotal":number,"discountAmount":number,"grandTotal":number,"technicalProposal":{"executiveSummary":string,"methodology":string,"personnel":string,"equipment":string,"siteOrganization":string,"mobilisationSchedule":string,"constructionSchedule":string,"otherInformation":string},"notes":string}. Include only relevant measured items; do not pad with fictional work items.`;
  }
  const prompt = baseBuildPrompt(type, values);
  if (type !== "escalation") return prompt;
  const overrideText = String(values.rateOverrides || "").trim();
  const realismInstruction = type === "bid" ? ` QUANTITY REALISM: ${ZAMBIAN_QUANTITY_RULES} Accuracy and realism take priority over matching the budget exactly. You may scale the scope to fit the stated budget, but if the described scope cannot realistically be delivered within ${values.budget || "the stated budget"} at minimum practical quantities, do not force the totals to match. Generate the realistic minimum-viable BOQ and set notes exactly to: Note: the described scope of works exceeds the stated budget of ${values.budget || "[budget]"}. A realistic minimum-viable BOQ is shown above; consider increasing budget or reducing scope.` : "";
  const scheduleInstruction = JSON.stringify(values.materialsSchedule || []);
  return `${prompt}\n\nSOURCE MATERIAL SCHEDULE (controlling values): ${scheduleInstruction}. Preserve every supplied material, quantity, unit, baseUnitPrice, currentUnitPrice, and source exactly. For each materialsSchedule line return quantity:number, unit:string, baseUnitPrice:number, currentUnitPrice:number, source:string, and do not replace the user-provided schedule with an estimate. CivilDocs will calculate the threshold, cap, floor, base/current amounts, and payable adjustment deterministically. RATE REFERENCE INSTRUCTION: Use the following CivilDocs Zambia reference estimates only where the user has supplied no schedule rate; do not invent a conflicting material rate. Reference rates: ${materialRateReferenceForPrompt()}. If the user has provided an explicit different rate below, the user's explicit rate takes priority: ${overrideText || "No user-specific rate overrides supplied."} Clearly label all reference rates as estimates requiring supplier quotation verification.${realismInstruction}`;
};

const inspectionPromptBase = buildPrompt;
buildPrompt = function(type, values) {
  const prompt = inspectionPromptBase(type, values);
  return type === "inspection"
    ? prompt.replace("Include 8 items.", inspectionItemCountInstruction(values.observations))
    : prompt;
};

const originalShowHome = showHome;
showHome = function() { reviewState = null; originalShowHome(); };
const originalShowForm = showForm;
showForm = function(id) { reviewState = null; originalShowForm(id); };

const budgetIndependentBidPrompt = buildPrompt;
buildPrompt = function(type, values) {
  const prompt = budgetIndependentBidPrompt(type, values);
  if (type !== "bid") return prompt;
  return prompt
    .replace(/ Stated budget:[\s\S]*?\. Procurement reference:/, " Budget is a client-side reasonableness check only and must not be inferred, used to scale quantities or rates, or referenced in your response. Procurement reference:")
    .replace(/ Accuracy and practical procurement take priority over matching budget\.[\s\S]*?consider increasing budget or reducing scope\./, " Accuracy and practical procurement take priority. Do not change the described scope, quantities or rates to target an unprovided budget and do not write a budget warning.");
};

const ZPPA_BOQ_SECTIONS = [
  { number:"1.00", title:"PRELIMINARIES AND GENERAL", test:/mobil|prelim|site establishment|temporary|insurance|security|supervision|quality|safety/i },
  { number:"2.00", title:"EARTHWORKS AND EXCAVATION", test:/excavat|earthwork|backfill|fill|compaction|subgrade|trench/i },
  { number:"3.00", title:"CONCRETE AND REINFORCEMENT", test:/concrete|reinforc|formwork|steel|rebar|foundation/i },
  { number:"4.00", title:"MASONRY AND STRUCTURAL WORKS", test:/brick|block|masonry|wall|render|plaster/i },
  { number:"5.00", title:"ROOFING, FINISHES AND FITTINGS", test:/roof|sheet|tile|paint|door|window|ceiling|fixture|fitting/i },
  { number:"6.00", title:"DRAINAGE, EXTERNAL WORKS AND REINSTATEMENT", test:/drain|culvert|pipe|road|paving|external|reinstat|landscape|fence/i },
  { number:"7.00", title:"OTHER MEASURED WORKS", test:/.*/i }
];
function buildZppaBoqSections(items) {
  const sections = ZPPA_BOQ_SECTIONS.map(section => ({ ...section, items:[] }));
  items.forEach(item => {
    const section = sections.find(candidate => candidate.test.test(String(item.description || ""))) || sections.at(-1);
    section.items.push(item);
  });
  return sections.filter(section => section.items.length).map(section => ({
    ...section,
    items: section.items.map((item, index) => ({ ...item, itemNo:`${section.number.slice(0, 1)}.${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}` })),
  }));
}
function recalculateBidTotalsForData(data) {
  data.subtotal = data.boqItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0);
  data.discountAmount = Math.max(0, Number(data.tenderDetails?.discountAmount ?? data.discountAmount ?? 0));
  data.grandTotal = tenderPriceAfterDiscount(data.subtotal, data.discountAmount);
}
function normalizeBidQuantities(data, values) {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.boqItems)) return;
  data.projectDetails = { ...data.projectDetails, projectName:values.projectName, location:values.location, client:values.client, preparedBy:values.preparedBy, currency:values.currency };
  data.tenderDetails = { ...data.tenderDetails, procurementTitle:data.projectDetails.projectName || values.projectName, procurementReference:values.procurementReference || data.tenderDetails?.procurementReference || "To be confirmed from the invitation for bids", invitationForBidNo:values.invitationForBidNo || data.tenderDetails?.invitationForBidNo || "To be confirmed from the invitation for bids", employer:data.projectDetails.client || values.client, location:data.projectDetails.location || values.location, issueDate:new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), submissionDate:values.tenderSubmissionDate || data.tenderDetails?.submissionDate || "", bidder:data.projectDetails.preparedBy || values.preparedBy, currency:data.projectDetails.currency || values.currency, billNumber:"Bill No. 1", bidValidity:values.bidValidityDays ? `${values.bidValidityDays} days` : (data.tenderDetails?.bidValidity || "As stated in the bidding document"), discountAmount:Math.max(0, Number(values.discountAmount || data.tenderDetails?.discountAmount || data.discountAmount || 0)), contractorRepresentative:values.contractorRepresentative || data.tenderDetails?.contractorRepresentative || "" };
  data.boqItems = data.boqItems.map(item => ({ ...item, quantity:practicalQuantityFor(item), rate:Number(item.rate || 0) }));
  data.boqItems.forEach(item => { item.amount = item.quantity * item.rate; });
  data.boqSections = buildZppaBoqSections(data.boqItems);
  data.boqItems = data.boqSections.flatMap(section => section.items);
  recalculateBidTotalsForData(data);
  const budget = Number(values.budget || 0);
  const currency = data.projectDetails?.currency || "ZMW";
  data.notes = budgetShortfallNotes(data.notes, budget, data.grandTotal, currency);
}
function recalculateBidTotals() {
  const data = reviewState.data;
  data.boqSections = buildZppaBoqSections(data.boqItems);
  data.boqItems = data.boqSections.flatMap(section => section.items);
  data.subtotal = data.boqItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0);
  data.discountAmount = Math.max(0, Number(data.tenderDetails?.discountAmount ?? data.discountAmount ?? 0));
  data.grandTotal = tenderPriceAfterDiscount(data.subtotal, data.discountAmount);
}
function renderReviewSummary() {
  clearPaymentReviewWarning();
  const bid = reviewState.type === "bid";
  const payment = reviewState.type === "payment";
  const variation = reviewState.type === "variation";
  reviewCard.hidden = true;
  reviewActions.hidden = true;
  reviewSummaryView.hidden = false;
  document.getElementById("review-progress-text").textContent = "Review complete";
  document.getElementById("review-progress-percent").textContent = "100%";
  document.getElementById("review-progress-bar").style.width = "100%";
  const summaryRows = [...document.querySelectorAll("#review-totals > div")];
  const setSummaryTotals = (labels, values) => {
    summaryRows.forEach((row, index) => {
      row.querySelector("span").textContent = labels[index];
      row.querySelector("strong").textContent = values[index];
    });
    document.getElementById("review-totals").hidden = false;
  };
  if (bid) {
    recalculateBidTotals();
    reviewSummaryList.innerHTML = reviewState.data.boqItems.map(item => `<article class="review-summary-item"><div class="review-summary-item__meta">Item ${escapeHtml(item.itemNo)} · ${escapeHtml(item.unit)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__title">${escapeHtml(item.description)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__details">Quantity ${Number(item.quantity || 0).toLocaleString()} × ${formatReviewMoney(item.rate)} = <strong>${formatReviewMoney(item.amount)}</strong></div></article>`).join("");
    setSummaryTotals(["Total measured works", "Discount offered", "Tender price after discount", "Rates / taxes basis"], [formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.subtotal), formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.discountAmount), formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.grandTotal), "Confirm issued BDS"]);
  } else if (payment) {
    recalculatePaymentCertificate(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
    updatePaymentReviewWarning(reviewState.data);
    const deductionSummary = `<article class="review-summary-item"><div class="review-summary-item__meta">Contract deductions to verify</div><div class="review-summary-item__title">Retention and contract-specific recoveries</div><div class="review-summary-item__details">Current retention ${formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.retentionAmount)} · Advance recovery ${formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.advancePaymentRecovery)} · Statutory deductions ${formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.statutoryDeductions)} · Other deductions ${formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.otherDeductions)} · <strong>Total deductions ${formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.totalDeductions)}</strong></div></article>`;
    reviewSummaryList.innerHTML = reviewState.data.lineItems.map(item => `<article class="review-summary-item"><div class="review-summary-item__meta">Item ${escapeHtml(item.itemNo)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__title">${escapeHtml(item.description)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__details">Previous ${formatReviewMoney(item.previousValue)} · Current period ${formatReviewMoney(item.valueThisPeriod)} · <strong>Cumulative ${formatReviewMoney(item.cumulativeValue)}</strong></div></article>`).join("") + deductionSummary;
    const settlement = paymentSettlementPresentation(reviewState.data.netPaymentDue);
    setSummaryTotals(["Current-period gross valuation", "Total current deductions", "Cumulative valuation", settlement.reviewLabel], [formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.grossValueThisPeriod), formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.totalDeductions), formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.cumulativeValue), formatReviewMoney(settlement.displayAmount)]);
  } else if (variation) {
    recalculateVariationClaim(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
    reviewSummaryList.innerHTML = reviewState.data.claimItems.map(item => `<article class="review-summary-item"><div class="review-summary-item__meta">Item ${escapeHtml(item.itemNo)} · ${escapeHtml(item.claimCategory)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__title">${escapeHtml(item.description)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__details">Cost impact ${formatReviewMoney(item.costImpact)} · <strong>Time impact ${Number(item.timeImpactDays || 0)} days</strong></div></article>`).join("");
    const original = Number(String(reviewState.values.originalValue || 0).replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, "")) || 0;
    setSummaryTotals(["Original contract value", "Total cost impact", "Revised contract value", "Total time impact"], [formatReviewMoney(original), formatReviewMoney(reviewState.data.costImpact), formatReviewMoney(original + Number(reviewState.data.costImpact || 0)), `${Number(reviewState.data.timeImpactDays || 0)} days`]);
  } else {
    reviewSummaryList.innerHTML = reviewState.data.inspectionItems.map(item => `<article class="review-summary-item"><div class="review-summary-item__meta">Item ${escapeHtml(item.itemNo)} · ${escapeHtml(item.status)} · ${escapeHtml(item.severityIfDefect)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__title">${escapeHtml(item.area)}</div><div class="review-summary-item__details">${escapeHtml(item.observation)}<br><strong>Action:</strong> ${escapeHtml(item.actionRequired)} · ${escapeHtml(item.dueDate)}</div></article>`).join("");
    document.getElementById("review-totals").hidden = true;
  }
  confirmBoqButton.textContent = "Confirm & Generate PDF";
}
function renderFlashReview() {
  const items = reviewItems();
  if (reviewState.index >= items.length) { renderReviewSummary(); return; }
  reviewCard.hidden = false;
  reviewActions.hidden = false;
  reviewSummaryView.hidden = true;
  const item = items[reviewState.index];
  const progress = Math.round(((reviewState.index + 1) / items.length) * 100);
  document.getElementById("review-progress-text").textContent = `Item ${reviewState.index + 1} of ${items.length}`;
  document.getElementById("review-progress-percent").textContent = `${progress}%`;
  document.getElementById("review-progress-bar").style.width = `${progress}%`;
  reviewPreviousButton.disabled = reviewState.index === 0;
  reviewKeepButton.hidden = reviewState.editing;
  reviewChangeButton.hidden = reviewState.editing;
  reviewCard.innerHTML = reviewState.type === "bid" ? renderBidCard(item, reviewState.editing) : reviewState.type === "payment" ? renderPaymentCard(item, reviewState.editing) : reviewState.type === "variation" ? renderVariationCard(item, reviewState.editing) : renderInspectionCard(item, reviewState.editing);
}
function showFlashReview(type, data, values) {
  reviewState = { type, data, values, index:0, editing:false };
  const inspection = type === "inspection", payment = type === "payment", variation = type === "variation";
  reviewBackButton.textContent = inspection ? "← Edit inspection details" : payment ? "← Edit certificate details" : variation ? "← Edit claim details" : "← Edit bid details";
  document.getElementById("review-code").textContent = inspection ? "Inspection item confirmation" : payment ? "Certificate valuation confirmation" : variation ? "Variation claim confirmation" : "BOQ item confirmation";
  document.getElementById("review-title").textContent = inspection ? "Review each inspection item." : payment ? "Review each valuation line item." : variation ? "Review each claim item." : "Review each BOQ line item.";
  document.getElementById("review-description").textContent = inspection ? "Keep the observation as it stands or change it before moving to the next item." : payment ? "Keep each valuation as it stands or change it before moving to the next item." : variation ? "Keep the claim impact as it stands or adjust it before moving to the next item." : "Keep the quantity and rate as they stand or change them before moving to the next item.";
  document.getElementById("rate-reference-note").hidden = inspection || payment || variation;
  renderFlashReview();
  showView(reviewView);
}
function advanceFlashReview() { reviewState.editing = false; reviewState.index += 1; renderFlashReview(); }
function saveFlashChanges() {
  const item = reviewItems()[reviewState.index];
  if (reviewState.type === "bid") {
    item.description = document.getElementById("flash-description").value.trim();
    item.unit = document.getElementById("flash-unit").value.trim();
    item.quantity = Number(document.getElementById("flash-quantity").value || 0);
    item.rate = Number(document.getElementById("flash-rate").value || 0);
    item.amount = item.quantity * item.rate;
  } else if (reviewState.type === "payment") {
    item.description = document.getElementById("flash-description").value.trim();
    item.previousValue = Number(document.getElementById("flash-previous").value || 0);
    item.valueThisPeriod = Number(document.getElementById("flash-current").value || 0);
    item.cumulativeValue = item.previousValue + item.valueThisPeriod;
    recalculatePaymentCertificate(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  } else if (reviewState.type === "variation") {
    item.claimCategory = document.getElementById("flash-category").value.trim();
    item.description = document.getElementById("flash-description").value.trim();
    item.costImpact = Number(document.getElementById("flash-cost").value || 0);
    item.timeImpactDays = Number(document.getElementById("flash-days").value || 0);
    recalculateVariationClaim(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  } else {
    item.area = document.getElementById("flash-area").value.trim();
    item.status = document.getElementById("flash-status").value;
    item.observation = document.getElementById("flash-observation").value.trim();
    item.severityIfDefect = document.getElementById("flash-severity").value;
    item.dueDate = document.getElementById("flash-due").value.trim();
    item.targetCloseoutDate = document.getElementById("flash-target-closeout").value.trim();
    item.responsibleParty = document.getElementById("flash-responsible").value;
    item.closeoutStatus = document.getElementById("flash-closeout-status").value;
    item.drawingSpecRef = document.getElementById("flash-drawing-ref").value.trim();
    item.evidenceReference = document.getElementById("flash-evidence-ref").value.trim();
    item.verificationBy = document.getElementById("flash-verification-by").value.trim();
    item.actionRequired = document.getElementById("flash-action").value.trim();
    item.affectedQuantity = document.getElementById("flash-affected-quantity").value === "" ? null : Number(document.getElementById("flash-affected-quantity").value || 0);
    item.unit = document.getElementById("flash-unit").value.trim();
    normalizeInspectionReport(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  }
  advanceFlashReview();
}
function finaliseReview() {
  if (!reviewState) return;
  if (reviewState.type === "bid") recalculateBidTotals();
  if (reviewState.type === "payment") recalculatePaymentCertificate(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  if (reviewState.type === "variation") recalculateVariationClaim(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  if (reviewState.type === "inspection") normalizeInspectionReport(reviewState.data, reviewState.values);
  const { type, data, values } = reviewState;
  latestPdf = renderPdf(type, data, values);
  latestFilename = filename(modules[type].short, type === "bid" ? data.projectDetails?.projectName || values.projectName || "Bid_Package" : data.project || values.projectName || "Document");
  document.getElementById("result-description").textContent = `Your confirmed ${modules[type].name} PDF is ready to download.`;
  document.getElementById("result-success-note").textContent = "Your confirmed PDF has been generated. Download it now or use the same button again if needed.";
  clearDraft(type);
  reviewState = null;
  showView(resultView);
}

reviewBackButton.addEventListener("click", () => { reviewState = null; showView(formView); });
reviewPreviousButton.addEventListener("click", () => { if (reviewState.index > 0) { reviewState.index -= 1; reviewState.editing = false; renderFlashReview(); } });
reviewKeepButton.addEventListener("click", advanceFlashReview);
reviewChangeButton.addEventListener("click", () => { reviewState.editing = true; renderFlashReview(); });
reviewCard.addEventListener("click", event => { if (event.target.closest('[data-flash-action="save"]')) saveFlashChanges(); });
reviewCard.addEventListener("touchstart", event => { reviewTouchStart = event.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive:true });
reviewCard.addEventListener("touchend", event => { const delta = event.changedTouches[0].screenX - reviewTouchStart; if (Math.abs(delta) > 70 && !reviewState.editing) { if (delta < 0) advanceFlashReview(); else if (reviewState.index > 0) { reviewState.index -= 1; renderFlashReview(); } } }, { passive:true });
confirmBoqButton.addEventListener("click", finaliseReview);

function expectedSkeletonRows(type,values){if(type==="variation")return values.claimType==="Both"?2:1;if(type==="grade")return Math.max(1,(values.completedProjects||[]).length);if(type==="escalation")return Math.max(1,(values.materialsSchedule||[]).length);if(type==="inspection"){const numbered=String(values.observations||"").match(/(?:^|[\s;])\d{1,2}[.)]\s/g)||[];return Math.max(8,numbered.length);}if(type==="bid")return 12;return 4;}
function skeletonColumnCount(type){return ({bid:6,payment:5,variation:5,grade:7,escalation:10,inspection:10})[type]||4;}
function skeletonRow(columns,className=""){return `<div class="skeleton-table__row ${className}" style="--skeleton-columns:${columns}">${Array.from({length:columns},()=>"<span class=\"skeleton-cell\"></span>").join("")}</div>`;}
function renderLoadingSkeleton(type,values){const rows=expectedSkeletonRows(type,values),columns=skeletonColumnCount(type);const tableRows=Array.from({length:rows},()=>skeletonRow(columns)).join("");const title=escapeHtml(modules[type]?.name||"document");return `<div class="loading-skeleton" aria-busy="true"><p class="loading-skeleton__label">Preparing the ${title} structure…</p><span class="skeleton-line skeleton-line--title"></span><span class="skeleton-line skeleton-line--wide"></span><span class="skeleton-line skeleton-line--short"></span><div class="skeleton-table">${skeletonRow(columns,"skeleton-table__row--header")}${tableRows}</div></div>`;}
function renderRequestStage(stage,type=selectedModule,values=collectValues()){const loading=document.getElementById("generation-loading");if(!stage||stage.mode==="hidden"){loading.hidden=true;loading.innerHTML="";return;}loading.hidden=false;if(stage.mode==="spinner"){loading.innerHTML=`<div class="loading-inline"><span class="spinner"></span>${escapeHtml(stage.label)}</div>`;return;}if(stage.mode==="skeleton"){loading.innerHTML=renderLoadingSkeleton(type,values);return;}loading.innerHTML=`<div class="loading-progress" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="${stage.progress}"><span class="loading-progress__label">${escapeHtml(stage.label)}</span><span class="loading-progress__track"><span class="loading-progress__bar" style="width:${stage.progress}%"></span></span><span class="loading-progress__note">Request state advances only while your active request is still waiting; this is not a completion estimate.</span></div>`;}
function updateNetworkState(){const offline=!navigator.onLine;document.body.classList.toggle("network-offline",offline);if(selectedModule&&!requestState.busy){generateButton.disabled=offline;}if(offline&&selectedModule&&!requestState.busy)showStatus("You’re offline. Your draft is saved on this device; reconnect before generating.","error");if(!offline&&selectedModule&&!requestState.busy&&status.textContent.includes("offline"))showStatus("You’re back online. Your saved draft is ready when you are.");}
function saveDraft(){if(!selectedModule)return;try{const values=collectValues();if(!hasMeaningfulDraft(values))return;localStorage.setItem(draftStorageKey(selectedModule),JSON.stringify({values,updatedAt:Date.now()}));requestState.draftStored=true;}catch(error){console.warn("CivilDocs could not save the local draft",error);}}
function readSavedDraft(moduleId){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(draftStorageKey(moduleId))||"null");}catch{return null;}}
function renderDraftExports(){draftExportsList.innerHTML=renderDraftExportRegisterHtml(savedDraftEntries(modules,readSavedDraft));}
function triggerDraftDownload(blob,filename){const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),link=document.createElement("a");link.href=url;link.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(link);link.click();link.remove();window.setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),0);}

Enter a project value first; it will be saved on this device.","error");else draftExportStatus.textContent="There is no saved draft to export for that document.";return;}const model=buildDraftExportModel(module,record.values);if(format==="word"){triggerDraftDownload(new Blob([buildDraftWordHtml(model)],{type:"application/msword;charset=utf-8"}),`${model.filenameBase}.doc`);draftExportStatus.textContent=`${module.name} draft downloaded as a Word-compatible document.`;return;}if(!window.jspdf?.jsPDF){draftExportStatus.textContent="Draft PDF export is temporarily unavailable. function handleDraftExportClick(event){const button=event.target.closest("[data-draft-export]");if(!button)return;const moduleId=button.dataset.draftModule||selectedModule;if(moduleId===selectedModule)saveDraft();exportDraft(moduleId,button.dataset.draftExport);}
function restoreDraft(id){try{const record=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(draftStorageKey(id))||"null");if(!record?.values)return;const values=record.values;Object.entries(values).forEach(([key,value])=>{const input=fields.querySelector(`[name="${key}"]`);if(input&&typeof value!=="object")input.value=value;});if(id==="grade")restoreDynamicRows("projects",values.completedProjects||[]);if(id==="escalation")restoreDynamicRows("materials",values.materialsSchedule||[]);requestState.draftStored=hasMeaningfulDraft(values);if(requestState.draftStored)showStatus("Saved draft restored on this device. function restoreDynamicRows(kind,items){if(!items.length)return;const list=fields.querySelector(`[data-dynamic="${kind}"] .dynamic-list`);while(list.children.length<items.length)list.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",dynamicRow(kind));[...list.children].forEach((row,index)=>{const item=items[index];if(!item)return;const set=(name,value)=>{const input=row.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`);if(input)input.value=value??"";};if(kind==="projects"){set("projectNameItem",item.projectName);set("projectClientItem",item.client);set("projectValueItem",item.value);set("projectYearItem",item.year);set("projectCertificateItem",item.completionCertificate);set("projectEvidenceItem",item.evidenceReference);set("projectEvidenceStatus",item.evidenceStatus);}else{set("materialItem",item.material);set("materialQuantityItem",item.quantity);set("materialUnitItem",item.unit);set("materialBaseRateItem",item.baseUnitPrice);set("materialCurrentRateItem",item.currentUnitPrice);set("materialSourceItem",item.source);}});}
function clearDraft(type){try{localStorage.removeItem(draftStorageKey(type));}catch{}requestState.draftStored=false;}
function warnBeforeLeaving(event){if(!selectedModule||requestState.busy||!requestState.draftStored)return;event.preventDefault();event.returnValue="You have a saved CivilDocs draft that has not yet been completed as a PDF.";return event.returnValue;}
function downloadLatestPdf(){latestPdf?.save(latestFilename);document.getElementById("result-success-note").textContent="Download requested. Keep this page open if you need to download the PDF again.";}
function completeGeneratedDocument(type,data,values){if(type==="bid")normalizeBidQuantities(data,values);if(type==="payment")normalizePaymentCertificate(data,values);if(type==="variation")normalizeVariationClaim(data,values);if(type==="grade")normalizeGradePortfolio(data,values);if(type==="escalation")normalizeEscalationClause(data,values);if(type==="inspection")normalizeInspectionReport(data,values);if(type==="bid"||type==="payment"||type==="variation"||type==="inspection"){showFlashReview(type,data,values);return;}latestPdf=renderPdf(type,data,values);latestFilename=filename(modules[type].short,values.projectName||values.companyName||"Document");document.getElementById("result-description").textContent=data.eligibilityWarnings?.length?`${data.eligibilityWarnings.join(" ")} Your ${modules[type].name} is ready to download as a PDF.`:`Your ${modules[type].name} is ready to download as a PDF.`;document.getElementById("result-success-note").textContent="Your PDF has been generated. function requestErrorDetail(error){if(error instanceof ClientRequestTimeoutError)return "This is taking longer than usual, so the request was stopped safely. submitDocument = function(event){event.preventDefault();clearStatus();if(!navigator.onLine){updateNetworkState();return;}if(requestState.busy||!validate())return;const values=collectValues();saveDraft();const stableModule=selectedModule==="bid"||selectedModule==="payment"?selectedModule:null;if(stableModule){const cached=readRepeatCache(stableModule,values);if(cached){showStatus(`Using the last successful result for these identical ${stableModule === "bid" ? const clearDraftBeforePilotPersistence = clearDraft;
clearDraft = function preservePilotDraft(type) {
  saveDraft();
  requestState.draftStored = true;
};

function cancelAutomaticRetry() {
  if (recoveryRetry.timer) window.clearTimeout(recoveryRetry.timer);
  if (recoveryRetry.ticker) window.clearInterval(recoveryRetry.ticker);
  recoveryRetry.timer = null;
  recoveryRetry.ticker = null;
  recoveryRetry.deadline = 0;
}

function updateAutomaticRetryCountdown() {
  const countdown = status.querySelector("[data-auto-retry-countdown]");
  if (countdown) countdown.textContent = retryCountdownLabel(recoveryRetry.deadline - Date.now());
}

function renderStructuredFailure(error) {
  saveDraft();
  const detail = describeGenerationFailure(error, { online: navigator.onLine });
  const mayRetryAutomatically = detail.canAutoRetry && recoveryRetry.automaticAttempts < 1;
  cancelAutomaticRetry();
  status.hidden = false;
  status.className = "status-message error recovery-panel";
  status.innerHTML = `<div class="recovery-panel__heading"><span aria-hidden="true">!</span><div><strong>Generation paused — your draft is safe</strong><p>Nothing you typed has been deleted.</p></div></div><dl class="recovery-panel__details"><div><dt>Reason</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(detail.reason)}</dd></div><div><dt>What happened</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(detail.whatHappened)}</dd></div><div><dt>Why</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(detail.why)}</dd></div><div><dt>Next action</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(detail.nextAction)}</dd></div></dl><div class="recovery-panel__actions"><button type="button" class="secondary-button" data-retry-now>Try again now</button>${mayRetryAutomatically ? `<button type="button" class="secondary-button" data-cancel-auto-retry>Keep editing</button><span class="recovery-panel__countdown">Automatic retry in <strong data-auto-retry-countdown>4:00</strong> — keep this tab open.</span>` : ""}</div>`;
  status.querySelector("[data-retry-now]")?.addEventListener("click", () => { cancelAutomaticRetry(); form.requestSubmit(); });
  status.querySelector("[data-cancel-auto-retry]")?.addEventListener("click", () => { cancelAutomaticRetry(); status.querySelector(".recovery-panel__countdown")?.replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "recovery-panel__countdown", textContent: "Automatic retry paused. Your saved form is ready whenever you are." })); });
  if (!mayRetryAutomatically) return;
  recoveryRetry.deadline = Date.now() + AUTOMATIC_RETRY_DELAY_MS;
  recoveryRetry.ticker = window.setInterval(updateAutomaticRetryCountdown, 1000);
  recoveryRetry.timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    cancelAutomaticRetry();
    recoveryRetry.automaticAttempts += 1;
    showStatus("Trying your saved form once more…");
    form.requestSubmit();
  }, AUTOMATIC_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
  updateAutomaticRetryCountdown();
}

const handleFormInputBeforeRetryRecovery = handleFormInput;
handleFormInput = function handleInputWithRetryRecovery() {
  if (recoveryRetry.timer) {
    cancelAutomaticRetry();
    recoveryRetry.automaticAttempts = 0;
  }
  handleFormInputBeforeRetryRecovery();
};

const showHomeBeforeRetryRecovery = showHome;
showHome = function showHomeWithRetryCleanup() {
  cancelAutomaticRetry();
  showHomeBeforeRetryRecovery();
};

submitDocument = function submitWithStructuredRecovery(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  clearStatus();
  if (!navigator.onLine) {
    renderStructuredFailure({ code: "OFFLINE" });
    return;
  }
  if (requestState.busy || !validate()) return;
  if (!shouldStartStressGeneration({ search:window.location.search, sessionStorage:window.sessionStorage, localStorage:window.localStorage })) {
    const usage = fairUseStatus(currentFairUse());
    showStatus(`Local pilot cap reached: this browser has recorded ${usage.used} of ${usage.limit} completed AI generations this month. The local tracker resets next month; see Pricing & Fair Use for details.`, "warning");
    renderFairUsePanel();
    return;
  }
  const values = collectValues();
  saveDraft();
  const stableModule = selectedModule === "bid" || selectedModule === "payment" ? selectedModule : null;
  if (stableModule) {
    const cached = readRepeatCache(stableModule, values);
    if (cached) {
      showStatus(`Using the last successful result for these identical ${stableModule === "bid" ? "bid" : "payment certificate"} inputs; no new AI request was made.`);
      completeGeneratedDocument(selectedModule, cached, values);
      return;
    }
  }
  lastPrompt = buildPrompt(selectedModule, values);
  setLoading(true);
  activeRequest = createStaircaseRequest({
    request: signal => callGemini(lastPrompt, signal, selectedModule),
    onStage: stage => renderRequestStage(stage, selectedModule, values),
    onOutcome: outcome => {
      activeRequest = null;
      setLoading(false);
      renderRequestStage({ mode: "hidden" });
      if (outcome.kind === "success") {
        try {
          recoveryRetry.automaticAttempts = 0;
          if (stableModule) writeRepeatCache(stableModule, values, outcome.value);
          recordStressGeneration({ search:window.location.search, sessionStorage:window.sessionStorage, localStorage:window.localStorage });
          completeGeneratedDocument(selectedModule, outcome.value, values);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(error);
          renderStructuredFailure(error);
        }
        return;
      }
      console.error(outcome.error);
      renderStructuredFailure(outcome.error);
    },
  });
};

init();

```

## `client/bid-package-content-utils.js`

```javascript
const PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN = /\[[^\]]*\]|\b(?:tbd|lorem|insert|to be confirmed|to be completed|bidder completion required)\b/i;

export function hasBidPackagePlaceholder(value) {
  return PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN.test(String(value ?? ""));
}

export function safeBidPackageText(value, fallback) {
  const normalized = String(value ?? "").trim();
  return normalized && !hasBidPackagePlaceholder(normalized) ? normalized : fallback;
}

export function buildBidPackageContent(input = {}) {
  const projectName = safeBidPackageText(input.projectName, "the stated works");
  const employer = safeBidPackageText(input.employer, "the procuring entity");
  const tenderer = safeBidPackageText(input.tenderer, "the tenderer");
  const submissionDate = safeBidPackageText(input.submissionDate, "the Bid Data Sheet submission date");
  const procurementReference = safeBidPackageText(input.procurementReference, "the supplied procurement reference");
  const invitationForBidNo = safeBidPackageText(input.invitationForBidNo, "the supplied invitation reference");
  const bidValidity = safeBidPackageText(input.bidValidity, "the Bid Data Sheet validity period");
  const tenderPrice = safeBidPackageText(input.tenderPrice, "the priced Bill of Quantities total");
  const contractorRepresentative = safeBidPackageText(input.contractorRepresentative, "the tenderer's nominated representative");

  return {
    packageContents: [
      "1. Tender cover letter and Letter of Bid using the employer-issued form.",
      "2. Priced Bill of Quantities / Schedule of Prices.",
      "3. Technical proposal, including method statement, programme, personnel, equipment and site organisation information.",
      "4. Qualification evidence and every Bid Data Sheet attachment required for this tender.",
      "5. Bid security or Bid-Securing Declaration where the Bid Data Sheet requires it.",
      "6. Signatory authority, joint-venture material where applicable, and other mandatory tender documents.",
    ].join("\n"),
    coverLetter: `We submit the priced tender package for ${projectName} to ${employer}. The offer is based on the attached priced Bill of Quantities and the tender documents issued by ${employer}.\n\nTenderer: ${tenderer}\nSubmission date: ${submissionDate}\nProcurement reference: ${procurementReference}\nInvitation for Bids reference: ${invitationForBidNo}\nTender price: ${tenderPrice}\nBid validity: ${bidValidity}\nContractor's representative if awarded: ${contractorRepresentative}\n\nThe authorised signatory for ${tenderer} must execute the employer-issued Letter of Bid and submit all required attachments with this package.`,
    drawingsChecklist: `Use the employer-issued drawing register as the controlling reference. Before submission, confirm that the tender package includes the applicable drawings and technical information for ${projectName}:\n\n1. General arrangement / site layout information.\n2. Drainage alignment, levels and cross-section information.\n3. Culvert location, detail and bedding information.\n4. Typical U-drain reinforcement, concrete and joint detail.\n5. Traffic-management, temporary-works and reinstatement requirements where applicable.\n\nThis preparation aid does not allocate, invent or certify drawing numbers; the bidder must rely on the issued tender documents and addenda.`,
    personnel: "Provide the tenderer's nominated personnel in the employer-required format, supported by CVs, registrations and availability evidence. Include only personnel actually proposed for this tender.",
    equipment: "Provide the tenderer's available equipment schedule in the employer-required format, supported by ownership, lease or hire evidence as applicable. Include only equipment that can be committed to these works.",
    siteOrganization: "Include the proposed project organisation chart, reporting lines and responsibilities required by the Bid Data Sheet and Employer's Requirements.",
    mobilisationSchedule: "Include a mobilisation schedule consistent with the issued tender programme, the stated mobilisation period and the tenderer's actual resources.",
    constructionSchedule: "Include a construction programme that reflects the tender method, resources, work sequence and the issued completion requirements.",
    otherInformation: "Attach only the additional technical information expressly requested by the Bid Data Sheet, Employer's Requirements and issued addenda.",
    qualificationChecklist: "1. Bidder Information Sheet.\n2. Joint-venture and signatory-authority material where applicable.\n3. Historical contract-performance declaration.\n4. Current commitments / works-in-progress information.\n5. Financial capacity, turnover and resources evidence.\n6. General and specific experience evidence.\n7. Proposed personnel forms and CVs.\n8. Equipment forms.\n9. Bid security or Bid-Securing Declaration where required.\n10. Other Bid Data Sheet-mandated attachments.",
  };
}
```

## `client/boq-utils.js`

```javascript
function roundToIncrement(value, increment) {
  return Math.round(Number(value || 0) / increment) * increment;
}

function normalizedDecimal(value) {
  return Number(Number(value).toFixed(1));
}

export function practicalQuantityFor(item) {
  const raw = Math.max(0, Number(item.quantity || 0));
  const unit = String(item.unit || "").toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "");
  const description = String(item.description || "").toLowerCase();
  const countBased = /\b(bags?|bricks?|blocks?|sheets?|tiles?|panels?|pieces?|items?|each|no\.?|numbers?|units?|doors?|windows?|fixtures?|fittings?|loads?|lots?|ls|lumpsums?|lengths?)\b/.test(`${item.unit || ""} ${description}`.toLowerCase()) || /roofing\s*(sheet|tile|panel)/i.test(description);

  if (countBased) return Math.max(1, Math.round(raw));
  if (unit.includes("m³") || unit.includes("m3") || unit.includes("cubicmet")) return Math.max(0.1, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.1)));
  if (unit.includes("tonne") || unit === "t" || unit.includes("metricton")) return Math.max(0.5, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.5)));
  if (unit.includes("kg") || unit.includes("kilogram")) return Math.max(1, Math.round(raw));
  if (unit.includes("litre") || unit.includes("liter") || unit === "l") return Math.max(1, Math.round(raw));
  if (unit === "m" || unit.includes("metre") || unit.includes("meter")) return Math.max(0.1, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.1)));
  if (unit.includes("m²") || unit.includes("m2") || unit.includes("sqm")) return Math.max(0.1, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.1)));
  if (unit.includes("hour") || unit.includes("hr") || unit.includes("day")) return Math.max(0.5, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.5)));
  return Math.max(0.1, normalizedDecimal(roundToIncrement(raw, 0.1)));
}

```

```javascript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { practicalQuantityFor } from "./boq-utils.js";

describe("practicalQuantityFor", () => {
  it("uses whole minimum units for count-based materials", () => {
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "bag", quantity: 0.01, description: "Cement" })).toBe(1);
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "unit", quantity: 2.4, description: "Common bricks" })).toBe(2);
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "bags", quantity: 4.6, description: "Damaged cement bags" })).toBe(5);
  });

  it("uses practical minimum increments for volume, steel, and liquids", () => {
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "m³", quantity: 0.002 })).toBe(0.1);
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "tonne", quantity: 0.1 })).toBe(0.5);
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "litre", quantity: 0 })).toBe(1);
  });

  it("rounds measured linear work to a tenth of a metre", () => {
    expect(practicalQuantityFor({ unit: "m", quantity: 7.24, description: "Drain lining" })).toBe(7.2);
  });
});
```
